title: IT Ticket BCIT-26-07714: Sunday Patch Window for BrennanAlert Console

fields.location: BCEMA EOC – Warning Officer position, mass notification console
fields.subject: SCHEDULED MAINTENANCE — Mass notification console workstation and BrennanAlert integration service
fields.description:
SCHEDULED MAINTENANCE — Mass notification console workstation and BrennanAlert integration service.

Monthly security patches will install Sunday 12/13 from 02:00 to 02:45 CST.

What to expect:
- Workstation BCEMA-EOC-WO1 will reboot automatically up to twice during the window.
- The BrennanAlert send queue will pause during each reboot. Messages queued during a pause will release when the integration service restarts.
- No action is needed if the window is acceptable.

To defer: reply DEFER with a business justification before Saturday 12/12 12:00 CST. Deferred changes move to the next approved maintenance window.

Ref CHG-1188.

This ticket was generated automatically by the change calendar. Replies go to the Change Management queue, which is staffed Monday–Friday 07:30–16:30.

activity.text: CHG-1188 approved at the weekly change review. Scope: monthly OS and browser security updates for county endpoints in Patch Group 3 (EOC and public safety consoles). Auto-reboot enabled, max 2. Stakeholder notice to be sent by automated job before the window.

instructorNote: This is a noise inject. The Warning Officer should reply DEFER, give active recovery messaging as the reason, and log the change. Watch for anyone blaming tonight's 1,142 failed texts on the patch. Those failures came from north-end cell towers losing power, and the patch window does not open until Sunday 02:00.
